tools.name: about_spineup
tools.title: About SpineUp
tools.description: Describe what SpineUp is, its four sections, and how it stores data. Useful for orienting before calling other tools.

tools.name: list_exercises
tools.title: List rehabilitation exercises
tools.description: List every scoliosis rehabilitation exercise in the SpineUp routine, with target duration and XP value.

tools.name: get_exercise
tools.title: Get exercise details
tools.description: Get the full step-by-step instructions and posture cue for one SpineUp rehabilitation exercise, by id or name.

exercise.description: Exercise id (e.g. 'cat-cow') or part of its name.

tools.name: get_progress_rules
tools.title: Explain XP and level rules
tools.description: Explain SpineUp's gamification rules (daily XP goal, XP per level) and optionally compute the level and progress for a given total XP.

totalXp.description: Optional total XP to convert into a level and progress percentage.
